question: Which of the following architecture is a memorial of Aurangzeb's wife, Dilras Banu Begum?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bibi Ka Maqbara.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bibi Ka Maqbara** is also known as the **"Tomb of the Lady".**
 
• It is located in **Aurangabad, India,** and was built by **Aurangzeb** in memory of his wife** Dilras Banu Begum.**
 
• The architecture of the tomb is** similar to that of the Taj Mahal, **with the use of **white marble** and intricate designs.
 
• However, it is often referred to as the** "Poor Man's Taj Mahal"** due to its smaller size and simpler design.
 
• It is considered to be one of the few examples of **Mughal architecture** in the Deccan region of India​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jama Masjid** is a **mosque **located in **Delhi, India, **built by** Mughal Emperor Shah **Jahan in the **17th century.**
 
• **Shah Begum's Tomb** is located in **Bhopal, India**, and was built in memory of **Sultan Shah Jahan Begum**, one of the **female rulers of Bhop**al.
 
• **Taj Mahal** is a **mausoleum** located in** Agra, India**, built by Mughal Emperor **Shah Jahan** in memory of his wife **Mumtaz Mahal.**
